request.diagnosis: The requested APIs belong in regex-syntax/src/lib.rs and the top-level regex src/lib.rs. regex-syntax already owns the escaping logic: escape calls escape_into, which prefixes each regex metacharacter with one backslash and currently reserves only text.len(), allowing reallocations for escaped inputs. Add documented public escape_len functions that compute text.len() plus the count of metacharacters (each adds one UTF-8 byte), make regex-syntax::escape use String::with_capacity(escape_len(text)), and have regex::escape_len delegate to regex-syntax::escape_len. Empty input then allocates nothing; nonempty escape uses one exact-capacity allocation; escape_into append behavior and existing escaping remain unchanged. The proposed review is syntactically scoped to two files, but compiler/tests and exact allocation behavior remain unverified in discovery.
